units.note: No verifiable per-token price was recorded; no USD figure is invented.

rationale.note: A failed call is paid for but produced no delivered checkpoint. The first attempt per cell is the probe; later failed attempts are repeats. The two retries that committed (T9-s1-E1-r2, T10-s1-E1-r1) are counted as committed calls, not failed repeats.

e1Economics.note: These are observed costs, not a counterfactual. Avoiding the failed calls would not automatically preserve the two retry commits.

caps.note: The manifest default 1,024 is the adapter default for ordinary requests, not the rationale cap. A single rationale request may reserve 16,384 output tokens against a 20,000-token per-cell cap; observed output remained far below either bound.
